title: Watersound 148 Coopersmith Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Amazing views of the coastal dunes and Gulf- 3 minutes to nearest beach boardwalk- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional $30/day fee- Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances- 4th-floor lookout tower- Covered porches- Multiple living areas- Screened balcony - Gas grill- 5 adult bikes- Golf cart- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: This 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home at 148 Coopersmith Lane in WaterSound sleeps 12 and has all the amenities guests crave. A large private pool, Gulf views, sitting areas on each level of the home, a screened porch, a golf cart, and even a separate workspace for those moments when professional and personal time mix.A primary bedroom, 2 guest bedrooms, and a laundry room are on the first floor. Dark hardwood floors and a 4-poster king bed create a romantic place to rest in the primary bedroom. A private bathroom has a classic claw-foot soaking tub and a separate shower. A guest bedroom with a king bed has a private bathroom with a spacious shower and access to the courtyard. A second guest bedroom has access to the courtyard and a beautiful 4-poster queen bed. Its private bathroom has a shower only. A spacious sitting area gives guests a space to rest or cool off after a day spent in the sun.On the second floor, an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining room with a vaulted ceiling provide lots of space for guests to spread out and relax. A dual commercial-sized refrigerator and freezer, premium stainless-steel appliances, and a large island give guests lots of space in the kitchen. A dining room with seating for 10 and a comfortable sitting area enjoy wooded views. A guest bedroom has a king bed and double-glass door that opens onto a porch and a private shower with a shower. A second guest bedroom has 2 twin beds, a light-filled reading nook, and shares a bathroom with a shower. A screened balcony has cushioned chairs so guests can enjoy the Gulf breeze.On the third floor, a sitting area with a foosball table and a flat-screen TV is sure to be a favorite hang-out spot for younger guests. 2 full beds enjoy a birds-eye view of WaterSound from a loft space.On the 4th floor, a lookout tower houses a desk and comfortable chairs. It's the perfect place to get a bit of work done while enjoying the views. With a house designed around guest comfort, 148 Coopersmith Lane will not be available for long! Take advantage of the included 5 adult bikes to explore WaterSound and adjacent 30A communities. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Laundry Room: Full-Size Washer and DryerSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR- Loft: Two Full BedsFOURTH FLOOR- Viewing Tower with Balcony*Unfortunately, the fireplace is not for guest use.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: This 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home at 148 Coopersmith Lane in WaterSound sleeps 12 and has all the amenities guests crave. A large private pool, Gulf views, sitting areas on each level of the home, a screened porch, a golf cart, and even a separate workspace for those moments when professional and personal time mix. A primary bedroom, 2 guest bedrooms, and a laundry room are on the first floor. Dark hardwood floors and a 4-poster king bed create a romantic place to rest in the primary bedroom. A private bathroom has a classic claw-foot soaking tub and a separate shower. A guest bedroom with a king bed has a private bathroom with a spacious shower and access to the courtyard. A second guest bedroom has access to the courtyard and a beautiful 4-poster queen bed. Its private bathroom has a shower only. A spacious sitting area gives guests a space to rest or cool off after a day spent in the sun. On the second floor, an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining room with a vaulted ceiling provide lots of space for guests to spread out and relax. A dual commercial-sized refrigerator and freezer, premium stainless-steel appliances, and a large island give guests lots of space in the kitchen. A dining room with seating for 10 and a comfortable sitting area enjoy wooded views. A guest bedroom has a king bed and double-glass door that opens onto a porch and a private shower with a shower. A second guest bedroom has 2 twin beds, a light-filled reading nook, and shares a bathroom with a shower. A screened balcony has cushioned chairs so guests can enjoy the Gulf breeze. On the third floor, a sitting area with a foosball table and a flat-screen TV is sure to be a favorite hang-out spot for younger guests. 2 full beds enjoy a birds-eye view of WaterSound from a loft space. On the 4th floor, a lookout tower houses a desk and comfortable chairs. It's the perfect place to get a bit of work done while enjoying the views. With a house designed around guest comfort, 148 Coopersmith Lane will not be available for long! Take advantage of the included 5 adult bikes to explore WaterSound and adjacent 30A communities. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
